surfaces.audience: Directory editors verifying the company and operating-business teams considering AI consulting in the Pacific Northwest or remotely.
surfaces.quality_metric: Genuine business inquiries describing a relevant workflow or system need; exclude operator checks and generic submissions from conversion evidence.
remaining_limitations: Linked case-study pages and research claims require separate evidence review.
Accessibility checks cover rendered text/control contrast, focus, keyboard use and reflow; this is not a full WCAG conformance audit.
